title: EnergyReport
description: Energy consumption and runtime report for an HVAC system over a time period.

thermostat_id.description: ID of the thermostat this report covers.

heating_runtime_minutes.description: Total minutes the heating system ran.

cooling_runtime_minutes.description: Total minutes the cooling system ran.

fan_runtime_minutes.description: Total minutes the fan ran independently.

average_indoor_temp.description: Average indoor temperature during the period.

average_outdoor_temp.description: Average outdoor temperature during the period.
